post.description:
Run audio extraction → transcription → candidate detection → scoring.

Runs synchronously today: the ASR engine is CPU-bound but bounded, and pretending to queue
work that no worker will pick up would be a lie. When Celery workers land, this endpoint will
enqueue and return immediately with the same response shape.

post.description:
Upload a source video.

Order of checks: CSRF → workspace membership → rights declaration → extension/MIME/magic
bytes → real `ffprobe` inspection. The file is spooled to a temp file (bounded by
`MAX_UPLOAD_MB`), validated, then streamed into storage, so memory use stays constant.
On any rejection the stored object is removed — no orphaned bytes, no half-ingested project.
